name: horde-breakers
description: Single-player zombie survival FPS for iOS.

scripts.prepare:web: mkdir -p www/assets www/vendor vendor && cp index.html game.js character.js weapons.js core.js maps.js www/ && rm -rf www/features && cp -R features www/ && cp -R assets/. www/assets/ && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.js www/vendor/ && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.js vendor/
scripts.sync:ios: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios
